body:
Part of General UI Polish (feature item 13). A setting for preferring panels on the left or right side of the screen, starting with the plan panel.

- `settings` gains a Panel side switch (Left/Right) stored in the settings store under a key beside `theme_key` (`solace-panel-side`), with `load`/`save`/`subscribe` as the theme uses.
- `strategy`'s plan panel follows it: the `.strategy` grid's `minmax(0,1fr) auto` becomes `auto minmax(0,1fr)` for left, and the plan panel's collapse/drag behavior keeps working on either side.
- The board's detail band (task 812bda5e156af79a) and any future docked panel read the same key, so one setting moves every docked panel.
- `shell.mjs` applies the stored value at page load, before the first paint, so panels do not flip after render.

**Tests:** settings tests for the new key's load/save/subscribe; strategy view tests for both grid orders; the frontend test checks the attribute is applied at load.
title: ui: Panel side setting
